# platform location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:platformLocation`](gmeow-platformLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/platformLocation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)

The geographic place where a sensor platform is situated. A platform typically has one location at a time; historical locations are modelled as past SensoryObservations or LocationStates, not by changing this property ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
